schema: CST-TT G12 raw native recharge declaration v1
target: explicit finite controlled factor and unbounded actual native event-register successor for TTS-04; no current promotion

domains.factor: Bool x Bool x Bool, all eight literal triples in product order
domains.removed_resources: false Bool account aliases all six declared roles
domains.run_register: Unit -> (Frame.State x Owner), unbounded Nat counter/ticks/residue; factor is finite

assignment.selected: owner specified by each control; current is pair.first, copied source is pair.second

patches.selected_native_arm_none: put NativePackagePrimitives.canonical (.inl owner) none, then fromArms
patches.selected_supplement_arm_none: put NativePackagePrimitives.canonical (.inr owner) none, then fromArms
patches.selected_current_recharge_zero: map selected bundle pair; replace only pair.first.native.temporal.ledger.recharge by 0
patches.selected_current_owner_source: map selected bundle pair; replace only pair.first.native.temporal.resource.owner by swapOwner owner
patches.selected_current_writers_false: map selected bundle pair; replace only pair.first.native.temporal.writers by fun _ => false
patches.selected_current_rows_zero: map selected bundle pair; replace only pair.first.native.temporal.rows by fun _ _ => []

runtime: ResourceCellReindex.raw id (fun _ p => (p.first.native,p.second.native)) (PublicationResources.runtime owner); same assignment, actual expressions/program/row/account/charge/withdrawal/record everywhere

raw_initializer.source: CellReindex.initializer id native_pair_projection (ModeExecution.initializer owner (swapOwner owner) (PublicationReplay.start owner))
raw_initializer.source_steps: PublicationReplay.copies owner - 1, event ((),false,history); canonical source policy is false and all source history factors are the selector
raw_initializer.receive_program: CellReindex.program id native_pair_projection (PublicationReplay.raw owner).receive; selected event (history,history)
raw_initializer.exit_program: translated same actual execution.program, event ((),false,history), exactly once
raw_initializer.composition: InitialProgramComposition.iterate source history_program then after actual receive_program then after exit_program. Do not supply a derived snapshot as initializer. Exact readiness must be proved from raw expressions for every partial assignment.
raw_initializer.entry_validation: actual translated AcquisitionExecution Entry/fromStart/postExit supported checks independently validate the initialized candidate; a syntactic initializer is not claimed to certify Entry for mutated controls
raw_initializer.released_entry_coverage: both PublicationResources entries, every factor selector; canonical target time derived as 2 for owner true, 6 for owner false

policy_recipe.selection: each control fixed selected_action, read from declared configuration; positive policy false for every factor/disturbance
policy_recipe.response: For each factor x, evaluate the same composed raw entry initializer at selector x, then derive a test register by setting its counter and tick fields to zero while retaining the actual initialized factor/residue/funding/owner. Use its actual translated runtime row for the fixed selected_action and Unit disturbance, actual charge.owner and debit/credit, actual updater destination factor, and natural before/after counter and record differences (the derived zero-counter test has both pre-readouts zero; positive canonical increments must be justified by actual read equations). Construct the response as a raw StaticView expression by substituting/composing those instructions; missing consumed inputs reject. No supplied derived snapshot, fabricated funded=true, or stored package/invariant/solvency/verdict primitive.
policy_recipe.package: NativeClosedPackage.package owner false on the same shared assignment; package-cell expressions preserve assigned raw bundles, with declared C4-C7 grades unchanged
policy_recipe.initial_observations: actual substituted/composed raw initialization followed by same native factor/progress/record/true-account balance expressions; missing consumed input None
policy_recipe.event_step: actual native decoded-policy ResourceRuntime.update, and generic EventState.step same factor/positive increments/debit/credit derived from response. Populate LocalBinding with actual local equalities before claiming infinite return.
policy_recipe.reserve: global maxCost over all factor/disturbance/outcome debits; greatest Retains is exact fixed-policy invariant using credit>=debit, not synthesis of all solvent policies
policy_recipe.non_t1_extension: unbounded event counters and exact Rat ledger in generic EventState; actual native registers retain existing unbounded Nat counters. No new physical or predictive-class data.

evaluation_contract.independent: exact Python raw interpreter and actual Lean optional-expression evaluation; no finite sampling used to prove all-time theorem
evaluation_contract.finite_coverage: every eight factor and Unit disturbance for both owners; controls fixed below; report raw initialized candidate, actual supported entry, native decode, response row/positive support, increment reads, account/charge ownership/debit/credit and ledger equation
evaluation_contract.proof_only: full eight-clause package/ResourceClosed/Legal/StepLaw, whole greatest/total and universal run laws must be kernel-proved; expensive checker proof caches require equality proofs and disclosure
evaluation_contract.negative_rule: direct actual readout refutations, not failed sufficient checks; absence of unconsumed other owner need not reject
evaluation_contract.failure_rule: retain any failed prediction without changing controls or raw recipes; no blanket all-negative-controls claim
evaluation_contract.resource_limit: unit-budget unrecharged native account becomes zero after actual exit; do not infer arbitrary-budget native negative balances from generic signed-Rat depletion theorem

claims_excluded: native negative balance from generic signed depletion
initializer Some iff actual supported Entry
